subject: Re: Quick win to get Nimbus across the finish line — limited trial uplift
messages:
From: Liam Chen <liam@nimbus.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Trial usage and final push

Connor —

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Quick summary: our engineering team has validated the integration and we’re seeing promising latency gains on the 8k context tests. We’ve burned through most of the trial allocation (attached Trial_Usage_Report.pdf) and are at risk of pausing tests next week unless we get a short extension or top-up.

Ask: would Redwood consider a 30-day trial extension plus an additional $5k credit to complete scope? This is time-sensitive — if we can close by EOW next week we’ll move to a paid Dedicated eval.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call to align.

—
Liam Chen
Head of ML Engineering, Nimbus Analytics
liam@nimbus.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: Trial_Usage_Report.pdf (pdf, 124KB)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-12T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Trial usage and final push — quick approval request

Forwarding Liam's note — quick context: Nimbus is engaged, good technical fit, looks like a high-propensity expand to Dedicated if we get them past this test. They are explicitly asking for a 30-day extension + $5k in credits.

Ask: Lauren — internal approval to offer the $5k trial uplift? Marissa — confirm finance ok to book this as a promotional credit and if any paperwork is required (MOU, amendments, accounting code). If approved I’ll send a short MOU and DocuSign.

Proposed constraints: one-time $5,000 promo credit, 30-day extension, no change to support tier. I’ll document in HubSpot (ND-4492).

Thanks —
Connor
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam@nimbus.ai>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-13T14:15:00-08:00
Subject: Offer: 30-day extension + $5k trial credit (MOU & DocuSign)

Liam —

Great news — we can do the 30-day extension and apply a one-time $5,000 promotional credit to your account. Per Lauren’s approval and Marissa’s finance checklist, I’m attaching the one-page MOU and a DocuSign link for signature.

Summary (what you’ll get):
- 30 calendar days of additional access starting on the date you sign the MOU.
- $5,000 applied as promotional credits that will consume usage for the extension period.
- No change to support level; standard hosted terms apply.

Next steps:
1) Sign the MOU via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/ND-4492-mou
2) I’ll confirm promo-code assignment and send instructions on how to track consumption in the Console.
3) At day 25 we’ll schedule a 30-minute check to review evaluation metrics and next steps for Dedicated if results look good.

Attachments: MOU_Nimbus_Redwood.docx

Let me know if you want a short call to talk through the MOU; otherwise I’ll assume signature is fine and proceed to issue the promo-code.

—
Connor O'Brien
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
connor.obrien@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0180
